description:
Portions of this trail network remains closed for wildfire recovery activities (for example, danger tree assessing and falling, area assessments, etc) and to prevent negative impacts to ecosystems and wildlife.
Click here:Tremont Wildfire
More Information on the motor-vehicle closure and maps can be found: by emailing regional resource management: 2021Wildlife.closures@gov.bc.ca or by calling 778 362-4683. Note that this is an answering service. Staff will return calls within two business days.

All ORV trails west of Greenstone lookout road remain closed as it accesses the Tremont wildfire (Canyon trail #14, Gap Trail #16, Upper Thickets #13).
title: Chuwhels-Inks ORV Trails
